ProductsTables and small tablesNinfea

The Ninfea leather coffee tables, conceived by Pietro Russo, are exquisite examples of formal perfection. They marry an elegant design with the meticulous handcrafting of leather and maple wood. The two coffee tables and the bedside table featuring the Ninfea door are as desirable as they are adaptable, offering an ideal fusion of three elements: metal, leather, and wood. This combination, enhanced by artisanal folding techniques, transforms them into unique and valuable pieces. To achieve the distinctive folds of the structure, solid maple strips, black leather, and additional maple strips are pressed together, ensuring a perfect interlocking that encases each table and supports the leather-covered top.
